Dear Madam
I am sorry to say [‘The Mice at Play’](../books.html#35) is gone out of print and I do not know how to recover it.

There are some nice plays for children by [Miss Jenner](../persons.html#762) called Terra Cotta plays published by Innes, and another set by [Mr A Heathcote](../persons.html#653) called Ragged Robin published by Allen.

The second among the latter is good for little children[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: CMY was evidently consfusing Amabel Jenner, Half-hour Plays: Rumpelstilskin and Other Plays from Old Fairy Tales.

Adapted either for the village school or the drawing-room (London: Smith 1889) and Constance M.

Prevost, Terra Cotta Plays (London, Smith 1888).

The other work mentioned is Arthur Malcolm Heathcote, Ragged Robin and Other Plays for Children (London: Allen 1890).
